intro: Who is Who: interview someone from another team, use AI to make a picture of your partner as a metaphor, then guess who is who.
interview.title: Interview! Find your partner (see your phone) and ask each other the three questions.
private.interview: Your partner: {partner} ({team}). Ask these questions: {questions}. Then you make a picture of {partner} as {theme}.
prompt.title: Write your prompt: picture your partner as a metaphor. No name, no appearance, no job title.
private.prompt: Describe {partner} as {theme}. Use what you heard, not what {partner} looks like.
tip.leak: Your prompt gives something away (name, looks or job): {words}. Please rewrite it.
tip.generic: Your prompt is still very general. Which detail from the conversation fits only {partner}?
tip.similar: Your prompt looks like another picture in the same round. Add something that only fits {partner}.
image.safety: No people, no faces, no text or letters in the image.
gen.progress: The AI is making the pictures: {done} of {total} ready.
round.title: Round {n}: who is who? Questions of this round: {questions}
round.skip: Round {n}: no pictures in this round.
private.badge: YOU ARE IN ROUND {n}. Hold up your phone: {name}. Answer one question per searcher.
private.search: Round {n}: find the people with a name badge, ask each one question and match the pictures on your phone.
round.reason: Round {n}: {correct} of {total} matched correctly, average {mean} per searcher ({members} searchers)
round.none: Round {n}: no searchers in the team (everyone was on a picture); compensated at the end
round.compensate: Compensation round {n}: no searchers, average of the other rounds ({mean})
commentary.fallback: Who would have thought {name} would be {theme}?
wall.title: The wall: all other pictures
finale.title: Finale: team portraits! Which picture belongs to which team? Double points.
finale.memory: Finale: do you remember? Match these pictures to the right name again. Double points.
finale.reason: Finale: {correct} of {total} correct, average {mean} per member × {mult}
finale.none: Finale: nobody from the team took part
results.title: Results: this is how the points were earned
merge.fallback: One creature that carries all of this
